summary: Reads up to 33 text lines through sub_491FB0, extracts a filename from each with sub_5654A0 using the aSourceMas token global, and attempts to load each file as a bitmap via BitmapLoader. Failures are formatted as 'Could Not Load MAS file %s (line %d)' into the byte_7CDCF0 UI buffer (line number read from this+0x18C) and reported through sub_493C80. The audio stream buffer is flushed before and after the pass; the function always returns 0.

operations.description: Flush the audio stream buffer with AudioStreamBufferRead(0) before the load pass.
Only enter the pass when sub_491FB0(this) supplies a first line.
Iterate up to 33 lines (countdown v2 from 32 down to 0 inclusive), continuing while sub_491FB0(this) still returns a line.
Extract a filename from the current line into the local 256-byte buffer with sub_5654A0 against the aSourceMas token global.
Attempt to load the extracted filename as a bitmap through BitmapLoader; success is indicated by a non-zero return.

On a load failure, format the aCouldNotLoadMa 'Could Not Load MAS file %s (line %d)' message into the byte_7CDCF0 buffer, substituting the filename and the line number this+0x18C via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
Report the formatted error through sub_493C80(1, byte_7CDCF0).
Flush the audio stream buffer again with AudioStreamBufferRead(0) after the pass.
